gepa-ai-gepa-gepa-optimize-anything.description: Automatically improve any text artifact that can be scored — prompts, programs/code, configs, specs, regex/SQL/schemas, agent scaffolds, or encoded search solutions — with optimize_anything, an LLM-driven optimization API: a search backend repeatedly proposes better versions from execution feedback and an evaluator you provide assigns the score (an objective metric or an LLM-as-judge for subjective tasks). optimize_anything is one interface across several optimizer backends — GEPA (reflective evolutionary search, the default), AutoResearch, MetaHarness — plus a best-of-N baseline: write the…
